decision_note: Two independent violations. (1) Escalates negative-outcome visual prominence once involvement crosses a threshold, the same anxiety-escalation shape panic_cap (severity block, 'no anxiety escalation') forbids. (2) Inverts its own cited evidence: description_as_reported states that higher-involvement users react MORE strongly to losses; the pattern turns that observed vulnerability into a reason to press harder specifically on those users. An observed vulnerability is not a licence to exploit it. Caught by review only — ANCHOR DOMAIN did fire (leaked 'greater','loss') but that check answers a different question and did not name the hard-rule violation; the D-329 gap recurring a third time.
